verdict.rationale: The axis applies to a UI library, but the evidence pack never documents an escape hatch for direct DOM access, such as refs or effects, for wrapping charting or visualization libraries. The createRoot and add-to-existing-page items [react-docs-8, react-docs-12, react-docs-29] cover embedding React inside a host page, which is the reverse direction and only an adjacent capability. Community comments about React's DOM abstraction do not show developer-side DOM manipulation either.
